description: A phototoxic skin reaction caused when plant-derived furanocoumarins contact the skin followed by ultraviolet A exposure.
causes: Skin contact with photosensitising plant sap or fruit containing furanocoumarins followed by sunlight exposure

appearance.general: Acute lesions may be linear, streaked, drip-shaped, or splattered on exposed skin; redness and blistering may occur.
appearance.dark_skin: Post-inflammatory hyperpigmentation may be more intense in skin of colour.

prevention: Avoid skin contamination with photosensitising plant sap or juice before sun exposure.
Use protective clothing when handling known causative plants.
